subject: Stage handoff: Horizon Systems — hotspot review & action list
messages:
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Jill Tanner <j.tanner@horizon-systems.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>, procurement@horizon-systems.com
Date: 2026-11-18T09:02:00-08:00
Subject: Stage handoff: Horizon Systems — hotspot review & action list

Team / Jill,

Quick context — finance asked for a short handoff on Horizon (DL-4729-HZN) after yesterday's AE sync. AE flagged a couple of late-stage blockers that could flip Nov commitment. I attached a one-page heatmap (Horizon_Risk_Heatmap.xlsx) that pulls together stage, owner, and the initial red/yellow/green assessment.

Asks: 1) Internal owners — please confirm owner + concrete next step by EOD tomorrow (Nov 19). 2) Jill / procurement — if there are outstanding procurement/legal items, flag them here so we can include in the save-play.

High-level:
- Revenue at-risk for Nov quarter: $325K commit.
- Primary friction: legal discount/approval + SSO integration timeline.

I recommend we treat this as an "at-risk commit" and prepare a short save-play that we can offer while keeping pricing discipline. I'll collate replies and circulate a single playbook.

Attachments: Horizon_Risk_Heatmap.xlsx

Thanks,
Markus
Markus Klein | Head of Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
m: (415) 555-0142

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>, Jill Tanner <j.tanner@horizon-systems.com>, procurement@horizon-systems.com
Date: 2026-11-18T11:15:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Stage handoff: Horizon Systems — hotspot review & action list

Markus — thanks for the note and the heatmap. I'll own the AE-facing follow-up today. Plan:
- 11:45 AM PST: quick call with Leo (AE) to confirm SSO timeline and engineering blockers.
- 2:00 PM PST: run a short exec outreach template to the Horizon sponsor to keep momentum.

I'll attach the current MAP doc and add a column for the proposed save-play options. Will update the heatmap with owners and ETA.

Attachment: Horizon_MAP.docx

—Marissa
Marissa Cole | Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference

From: Jill Tanner <j.tanner@horizon-systems.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@horizon-systems.com
Date: 2026-11-19T08:30:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Stage handoff: Horizon Systems — hotspot review & action list

Markus / Marissa — thanks for the heatmap. Quick update from our side: legal is still reviewing the proposed discount language and our procurement team needs final sign-off. That review is likely to push any contract signature into late December unless we can limit the wording changes.

Separately, the SSO integration is moving but engineering wants an additional week to validate SAML assertions with our dev env. Current internal expectation is we can have SSO in place mid-December.

I appreciate the offer of a save-play; procurement@horizon-systems.com is copied. If there is a short-term pilot extension or trial we can sign immediately to preserve momentum, that could help keep product teams engaged.

—Jill
Jill Tanner | Dir. of IT Ops
Horizon Systems

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: Jill Tanner <j.tanner@horizon-systems.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>, procurement@horizon-systems.com
Date: 2026-11-19T10:12:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Stage handoff: Horizon Systems — hotspot review & action list

Jill — appreciate the visibility. Proposed save-play (for internal approval):
- 45-day pilot extension at current seat levels (no additional cost) to keep the product team engaged.
- Limited commercial concession: one-time onboarding credit (not a recurring discount) contingent on final DocuSign acceptance by Dec 10.
- Technical: offer a dedicated integration slot with our Solutions Eng team to accelerate SSO validation.

Internal — can Rishi + Marissa confirm owners for: legal follow-up, procurement negotiation, and solutions-eng scheduling by EOD today? I attached a short save playbook that we can share with Horizon if we agree.

Attachments: Horizon_Save_Playbook.pdf
Links: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/HS-4729 , https://docusign.com/ABC-Envelope-12345

If we align quickly, Marissa can offer the pilot extension to Jill immediately and procurement can start approval in parallel.

Thanks,
Markus

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>, Jill Tanner <j.tanner@horizon-systems.com>, procurement@horizon-systems.com
Date: 2026-11-19T15:40:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Stage handoff: Horizon Systems — hotspot review & action list

Quick summary after syncing with AE and SE:
- Red (at high risk): procurement legal hold on commercial terms — blocker to signature. Owner: Marissa. Next step: legal-to-legal call; target by 2026-11-24.
- Yellow (medium risk): SSO validation — SE dedicated slot scheduled; owner: Stephanie. Next step: SE-run POC by 2026-12-03.
- Green (low risk): engineering POC results and product fit — owner: Leo (AE). Good early usage metrics.

Recommendation for Finance / Forecast: move stage to "Commit - At Risk" and mark amount $325,000 as at-risk for Nov. Please include the Horizon_Save_Playbook.pdf in the customer packet if Marissa offers the pilot extension.

HubSpot: HS-4729 — I'll add the legal action item and set a follow-up task for Nov 24. Marissa, please update the deal stage and attach the heatmap.

—Rishi
Rishi Malhotra | Senior Sales Ops Analyst
Redwood Inference

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jill Tanner <j.tanner@horizon-systems.com>, procurement@horizon-systems.com
Date: 2026-11-20T11:15:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Stage handoff: Horizon Systems — hotspot review & action list

All — thanks. I've scheduled a 30-min SE slot for SSO triage on 2026-11-23 at 10:00 AM PST and invited Horizon eng. I'll prepare an integration checklist and confirm resource availability.

Marissa — once you offer the pilot extension, please copy the save-play doc and indicate the onboarding credit terms (one-time). Jill — can procurement confirm whether a pilot extension requiring a PO would be sufficient to keep the team engaged while legal finishes wording?

I'll update the heatmap with the SE slot and mark items accordingly. If there are no objections, I'll close the loop and set the follow-up reminder for Nov 24 (legal call).

—Stephanie
Stephanie Nguyen | Customer Solutions Lead
Redwood Inference
